We need a strong BA for completing BA phase of the new upcoming project and then potentially working on the development phase (if case he’s needed).

Important BA to have deep expertise in fintech solutions developments, namely wallet applications for salary payments, money transfers, and other financial transactions. Also to have experience working with payment and bank integrations, and data migration.

Key responsibilities:

  • Elicit, analyze, validate, and document the business needs of stakeholders, customers, and end-users, ensuring strategic alignment with business objectives.
  • Collaborate with the client, project manager, and development team, acting as the key liaison between stakeholders and the software development team.
  • Decompose complex requirements into concise, clear user stories with unambiguous acceptance criteria.
  • Organize effective and efficient communication channels with the development team to ensure proper and timely implementation in line with requirements.
  • Lead the identification, analysis, and selection of the optimal solution scope according to the customer’s business requirements.

Hard skills requirements (including years):

  • 6+ years of experience working as a business analyst; preferably within a software development environment.
  • Deep expertise in fintech solutions developments, namely wallet applications for salary payments, money transfers, and other financial transactions.
  • Experience in creating e-wallets and their integration into existing products
  • Experience in working with BANK API and integration with them
  • Experience in working with payment processors & providers and their integration
  • Understanding of different types of payments (p2p, peer-to-peer, recurrent, transfers) and flow
  • Important to have experience working data migration.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of business analysis, requirements management, and Agile delivery principles.
  • Proven experience in eliciting and documenting requirements in the form of user stories, use cases, and functional specifications.
  • Ability to create comprehensive software requirements specifications (SRS). • Strong grasp of software architecture, including Web applications, and a deep understanding of software/systems (UML).
  • Proficiency in modeling business processes, knowledge of notations and methodologies (BPMN).
  • Ability to interpret, structure, and clarify complex information into clear, actionable requirements.
  • Experience leading workshops to gather requirements, build solutions, and present features.
  • Excellent communication skills.

The essence of the project: New e-wallet app for Asia and Israel market.

This existing fintech business currently serves two thousand of clients in Israel. The business operates in the agriculture and construction sectors, providing workers with a wallet application for salary payments, money transfers, and other financial transactions.

Current Challenges: The existing system, which includes a core wallet system and a CRM, has been facing performance issues. The client want to rewrite it from scratch.

Data Migration: essential to migrate the existing database and functionality to the new system to ensure continuity of service for your customers

Project life cycle
From scratch but keeping the database and core functionality of the existing solution.
Duration - 3-5 weeks should be for BA phase. Then might be time-gap for approving the results and plan with the client, then a full-time development phase is expected

ABOUT US

Here at MVB, our company culture defines the environment in which Team Members thrive. Our culture impacts a wide range of elements, including our purpose, values, expectations and goals that support growth and engagement – it is the secret sauce of our organization!
Our values live at the core of all that we do – Trust, Commitment, Teamwork, Adaptive, Respect, Love and Caring are our foundation for success.
MVB Financial Corp. (“MVB Financial” or “MVB”), the innovative financial holding company of MVB Bank, Inc., is publicly traded on The Nasdaq Capital Market® under the ticker “MVBF.” Through its subsidiary, MVB Bank, Inc., (“MVB Bank”) and the bank’s subsidiaries, MVB provides services to individuals and corporate clients in the Mid-Atlantic region, as well as to Fintech, Payment and Gaming clients throughout the United States. For more information about MVB, please visit www.mvbbanking.com.

Candidates must reside in one of the following states: West Virginia, Virginia, Texas, Florida, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Maryland, Washington D.C., New York, New Jersey, Arizona, North Carolina, Georgia, or South Dakota.

ABOUT THE ROLE

MVB sits at the center of a fast-growing ecosystem of fintech partners, payment processors, and core banking infrastructure, one that grows more sophisticated every quarter. This role serves as the primary liaison between MVB's fintech stakeholders and its shared services and core teams, diagnosing non-standard integration needs and translating them into solutions that can be scoped, documented, and built. The work spans partnering with fintech teams to assess new and expanding fintech relationships, partnering with core vendors to scope new integration capabilities, and leading cross-functional discussions through to a documented, supportable resolution.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Serve as the primary technical liaison between our Fintech stakeholders and MVB's Shared Services and core product teams for complex, non-standard integration needs.
  • Support the assessment of new fintech and processor integration requirements, with fluency in funds flow and data flow design.
  • Diagnose scoped technical requirements for evolving or expanding fintech relationships and translate them into actionable, documented solutions.
  • Partner with core vendor relationships to scope and develop new integration capabilities that don't yet exist in MVB's standard toolkit.
  • Lead cross-functional integration discussions through to completion, ensuring documentation is established and maintained for future support.
  • Provide consultative support for specialized payment and data exchange configurations, including file-based delivery formats and secure data exchange setup.
  • Partner with the Core Integration Consultant on engagements that require deep core banking expertise, and provide technical direction on shared integration work.

EDUCATION & WORK EXPERIENCE

  • 5+ years of experience in core banking implementation, payments operations, or fintech/BaaS integration, ideally spanning both the bank and vendor or processor side.
  • Demonstrated experience designing or supporting non-standard payment or account integrations, not just standard onboarding or turn-up work.
  • Strong understanding of ACH, wire, and check/image processing mechanics, including file formats such as X9.
  • Experience partnering with core banking vendors on solution scoping, ideally including direct vendor relationship experience.
  • Excellent written communication skills, with demonstrated ability to produce technical documentation that a third party can execute against.
  • Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent professional experience.

BENEFITS AT MVB

MVB Financial Corp., (“MVB”) offers an excellent selection of benefits for regular, part-time and full-time Team Members, including:

Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance

• Health Savings Account (HSA), Health Reimbursement Account (HRA) & Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
• Short- and Long-Term Disability Plan
• Group Life Insurance
• 401K Salary Deferral Plan
• Wellness Program
• Education & Tuition Expense Reimbursement
• PTO and Unique Vacation Purchase Program

• Nationwide Pet Insurance Coverage

We encourage you to submit an application even if you haven’t performed every job duty listed above, as your skills may be transferrable. MVB is looking for ambitious individuals with related knowledge, understanding and abilities who are willing to learn and grow. What we care about most is allowing you to develop and, in return, you help us become a stronger, more diverse and well-rounded organization.

Position Summary

Work Location:

***This is a remote position and can be located anywhere in the U.S.A.***

We define fintech partnerships. The Bancorp does more than enable payments innovation. We work side by side with clients, combining deep expertise with a technology-forward approach to deliver creative, practical solutions. We don’t settle for what’s possible today. We look ahead to what’s next, helping clients grow and innovate with confidence.

The VP Fintech Sales Executive role is a high-impact, revenue-driving role which is central to scaling the bank’s position as a leading Fintech sponsor bank and infrastructure provider in the embedded finance ecosystem. This role is responsible for driving strategic partnerships that fuel revenue growth, expand market presence, and enable innovative financial products—while ensuring alignment with regulatory and risk standards.

Key Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

  • Business Development & Pipeline Creation
    • Drives new partner acquisition across fintechs, marketplaces, and enterprise brands pursuing embedded finance strategies.
    • Proactively builds and manages a high-value pipeline through outbound prospecting, industry networks, and strategic partnerships.
    • Identifies and prioritizes high-impact opportunities aligned with the bank’s growth strategy.
  • Enterprise Sales Execution
    • Leads complex, multi-threaded enterprise sales cycles involving founders, C-suite executives, and cross-functional stakeholders.
    • Maintains control and momentum throughout the sales process, proactively addressing internal and external blockers.
    • Consistently progresses deals from initial engagement through contract execution.
  • Deal Structuring & Commercial Strategy
    • Structures and negotiates commercial partnerships, including program design, pricing, revenue share models, and contractual terms.
    • Translates sophisticated client use cases into scalable sponsor bank program designs (e.g., card issuing, deposits, payments).
    • Ensures all deals align with regulatory requirements and the bank’s risk appetite.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership
    • Acts as the primary deal quarterback, driving alignment across compliance, risk, legal, finance, and product teams.
    • Navigates internal processes efficiently to accelerate deal timelines and reduce friction.
    • Partners closely with internal stakeholders to ensure successful program design and launch readiness.
  • Client Advisory & Market Leadership
    • Establishes credibility as a trusted advisor on regulatory frameworks, program governance, and go-to-market strategy.
    • Represents the bank as a thought leader within the fintech ecosystem through events, partnerships, and industry engagement.
    • Builds long-term relationships with senior stakeholders across client organizations.
  • Pipeline Management & Forecasting
    • Maintains accurate pipeline tracking, forecasting, and reporting.
    • Provides clear visibility into deal progression, risks, and revenue expectations.
    • Consistently operates with a high degree of discipline and accountability in sales reporting

    Qualification Requirements

    Qualification Requirements

    • 6+ years of experience of enterprise sales or business development experience in fintech, banking, payments, or BaaS.
    • Proven track record of hunting, developing, and closing complex, high-value deals (multi-million dollar partnerships preferred)
    • Direct experience with sponsor bank models, embedded finance, or program management ecosystems
    • Strong understanding of regulatory requirements (KYC, AML, consumer compliance, third-party risk) and their impact on deal structuring
    • Demonstrated ability to navigate and influence multiple stakeholders across both client organizations and internal teams
    • Exceptional negotiation, deal structuring, and commercial acumen
    • High sense of ownership, urgency, and resilience in long, complex sales cycles
    • Executive presence with the ability to engage founders, C-suite leaders, and senior decision-makers
    • Strong fluency in API-driven financial infrastructure.

    What Success Looks Like

    • Consistently achieves and exceeds aggressive new business revenue targets.
    • Builds and converts a strong pipeline of enterprise fintech and embedded finance opportunities.
    • Successfully closes complex, strategic partnerships aligned with the bank’s risk appetite and growth strategy.
    • Demonstrates disciplined pipeline management and accurate forecasting.
    • Drives momentum across internal stakeholders to accelerate deal timelines and reduce friction.
    • Reinforces the bank as a top-tier sponsor partner for enterprise fintech programs.

    Why This Role Matters

    This role is critical to advancing the bank’s leadership in embedded finance by securing and launching high-impact partnerships. The Fintech Sales Executive directly contributes to revenue growth, ecosystem expansion, and the delivery of innovative financial solutions at scale, while ensuring the highest standards of compliance and risk management are upheld.

    About Huzzle

    At Huzzle, we connect exceptional talent with top opportunities at leading companies across the UK, US, Canada, Europe, and Australia. Our clients include fast-growing startups, digital agencies, SaaS companies, and tech-enabled businesses across industries such as MarTech, FinTech, EdTech, and eCommerce. Unlike traditional outsourcing agencies, we place you directly with innovative companies where you become a valued member of the team.

    Job Summary

    This is a rare 0→1 Founding Engineer opportunity to build a financial platform from the ground up within an already established and profitable ecosystem.

    We are looking for an exceptionally strong, hands-on engineer with direct fintech experience who has previously built core banking, payments, ledger, cards, or money-movement infrastructure at an established fintech, neobank, or financial technology company.

    This is not a management-first position. We need someone who still wants to architect systems, solve difficult technical problems, and write production code. You will work directly with the founders and an existing technical developer, taking significant ownership of the architecture, product, and technical direction.

    As the platform scales, you will also have the opportunity to help shape and build the engineering team around you.

    Key Responsibilities

    • Architect and build core financial infrastructure, including accounts, balances, ledgers, transaction state machines, and money-movement systems.
    • Build KYC/KYB, onboarding, compliance, permissions, limits, and approval workflows.
    • Design integrations with banking partners, card issuers, payment rails, FX providers, and other financial infrastructure partners.
    • Develop provider-independent architecture that supports multiple banking and financial providers without vendor lock-in.
    • Build secure, reliable APIs and financial data models capable of handling reconciliation, event processing, retries, and exception handling.
    • Own technical problems end-to-end, from architecture and database design through implementation and production deployment.
    • Work directly with the founders to translate product requirements and business constraints into scalable technical solutions.
    • Help establish engineering standards, technology choices, and the long-term technical direction of the platform.

    Requirements

    • 3–8+ years of professional software engineering experience with strong backend or full-stack fundamentals.
    • Direct experience building financial infrastructure within a fintech, neobank, payments company, or similar financial technology environment.
    • Experience with core banking, payments, ledgers, cards, FX, reconciliation, KYC/KYB, or money movement.
    • Proven experience building production-grade APIs and distributed systems.
    • Strong database architecture and data-modeling skills.
    • Experience with asynchronous workflows, queues, events, retries, idempotency, and transaction processing.
    • Strong engineering judgment and product instincts, particularly when balancing speed, scalability, reliability, and correctness.
    • Comfortable operating in a highly ambiguous 0→1 environment and taking significant ownership without requiring extensive direction.
    • Natural initiative, creativity, and problem-solving ability.
    • Highly hands-on and excited to continue writing production code rather than moving into a primarily managerial role.

    Nice-to-Haves

    • Experience as a strong individual contributor, early engineer, founding engineer, or technical lead within a high-growth fintech.
    • Background at companies such as Revolut, Wise, Monzo, N26, Nubank, Brex, Stripe, Plaid, Airwallex, Nium, Razorpay, Adyen, Checkout.com, PayPal, Column, Modern Treasury, or similar.
    • Deep understanding of financial ledgers, reconciliation, transaction processing, or money-movement architecture.
    • Experience integrating multiple banking, payment, card, or financial infrastructure providers.
    • Familiarity with regulatory and compliance requirements surrounding KYC/KYB and international financial services.
    • Experience building multi-currency, FX, card issuing, or cross-border payments products.
    • Previous experience helping build a product or engineering function from an early stage.

    Benefits

    💰 Milestone-based compensation

    🌎 Fully remote and flexible work environment

    🚀 High-impact founding role with 0→1 ownership

    📈 Direct influence over architecture and technical direction

    🎯 Opportunity to build on top of an already profitable platform

    🛠️ Modern tech stack and provider-agnostic architecture

    🧠 Collaborative environment working directly with experienced founders

    About Engine

    Engine is the AI-native platform for intelligent travel. For a decade, Engine has built the proprietary technology and supply behind modern business travel, serving over 40,000 customers and nearly 2 million travelers, along with leading travel and AI companies that build on Engine's infrastructure. One system powers business travel, group travel, human agents, and AI agents.

    That work has earned recognition as one of Fast Company's Best Workplaces for Innovators (2025), TravelTech's Reservation Platform of the Year (2026), and one of Built In's Best Places to Work (2020–2026).

    We're looking for bold, ambitious people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel. Working here, you can expect exponential growth, an ambitious pace, full ownership, and high-caliber colleagues who push you to do the best work of your career. Every hire raises the bar.

    Come outpace the ordinary and build the future of travel with us.

    About the Role

    We are looking for a Staff Product Designer to help lead our FinTech Design here at Engine. Whether it be beautifully simple payment experiences, designing frictionless complex billing portals, or our first credit card, this team is spearheading our entire fintech play from a design standpoint.

    As a Staff Product Designer, you’ll lead projects of significant scope and complexity from vision to execution. When we say vision, we mean it. Projects start with where we’re headed, so we know how to get there.

    Design at Engine is made up of 30+ incredible Product Designers, Creatives, Art Directors, Brand Managers, and leaders driving product vision and shaping a Design culture like no other.

    Designers at Engine are part of what we call the Big 4—the core team of Product, Design, Engineering, and Data that drive the roadmap and vision for their area. Together, you’ll shape strategy for your area and ship features that have immediate and lasting impact on the product.

    Successful designers at Engine chase opportunities, have strong conviction, and hold a high bar for product excellence. If that sounds like you, let’s go!

    Here's What You'll Do

    • Partner closely across disciplines to define and deliver features that meet real user needs.
    • Turn complex ideas into clear, simple flows.
    • Design for the best outcomes.
    • Build trust and collaboration with product, engineering, and design peers while raising the quality bar across the org.
    • Lead design reviews, refine how we gather feedback and make decisions.
    • Continuously push fellow designers to sharpen their craft and clarity.

    Here’s What You Get

    At Engine, extraordinary effort is met with extraordinary returns. We turn ambitious employees into industry leaders by providing:

    • Unmatched Growth: You’re surrounded by the best in the biz and we invest in our top performers.
    • Ownership and Freedom: You're a driver, not a passenger, of our success.
    • Rebellious Spirit: We never say no to a good idea and are willing to take smart risks.
